title: Lil' Timmy's Datapack
description: Just like little timmy levels, being hard by throwing unfair garbage at you
body:
**Lil Timmy's Datapack**

Unfairly harder than normal Minecraft

Features including:
- Makes mobs spawn with OP armor
- Harder Recipes
- Iron Golems, Wither Skeletons breaks blocks
- Bats gives you the darkness effect
- Wolves, Iron Golems, Enderman attack you on sight
- Passive animals are replaced with hostile mobs
- You only have 5 hearts



Should download if want to ~~suffer~~ have a **_harder_** challenge!
